name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Cincinnati Sales & Distribution Center, OH

fieldNotes.facility: Coca-Cola Consolidated Cincinnati Sales & Distribution Center. The roster address (1547 Kemper Meadow Dr, Cincinnati OH 45240) is in the Kemper Meadow / Forest Park business park. The roster lat/lng (39.292889,-84.53697, RANGE_INTERPOLATED) landed at the Kemper Meadow Dr intersection ~250m southwest of the building; corrected to the large flex/warehouse building at 39.29470,-84.53630.
fieldNotes.identification: MEDIUM confidence on building identity. The candidate is a large flex/warehouse building with an attached office wing on Kemper Meadow Dr; satellite shows white trailers and red-cab (Red Classic, Coca-Cola Consolidated's logistics fleet) tractors backed into a dock row on its NW face plus a small trailer drop yard - consistent with a Coca-Cola sales/distribution center. No road-level Coca-Cola signage was confirmable: Street View on Kemper Meadow Dr is from 2019 and the dock side is screened by mature trees.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or guard booth visible. The building is a typical open business-park flex property; truck access is via an open internal driveway off Kemper Meadow Dr. Listed uncertain because the dock side is tree-screened from Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock-door row on the NW face with ~10-15 trailers backed in; banded 10-25. Estimated from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Small trailer drop yard on the NW with a handful of trailers; banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropYard: True - a small dedicated trailer-parking area adjacent to the dock row.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Modest paved apron between the road and docks; stacking room for only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single warehouse building with an attached office wing.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Cincinnati metro (Forest Park, 45240), in an established business park beside the Ronald Reagan Cross County Hwy; classified Urban.
